description: Top-level interactive shell harness that drives the full FreeBSD kernel QA lifecycle via a persistent action menu.
Persists and restores QA session state across reboots and re-invocations; provides three resume modes (reuse/modify/new).
Execution and logging layer: wraps all shell commands with timestamped logging, live spinner for long operations, and PASS/FAIL recording.
Actions 1-4: clone/fetch the QA branch, build world+kernel, install, and verify the running kernel matches the expected SHA.
Produces machine-readable results.tsv and a human-readable qa-report-<timestamp>.txt after every test run.

Per-ticket QA test scripts under qa-branches/<QA_ID>/ that validate specific kernel patches; includes SWLSVROS-6363 (PMC/TSC), SWLSVROS-6414 (Zen6 IBS ibs_ctl2 init + EXTERROR, QA-PASS 2026-05-19), and SWLSVROS-6519 (IBS errata #1238/#1293 Family 19h, cycle 2).
AMD's FreeBSD kernel source repository, available via HTTPS (GitHub) and SSH (internal AMD git server).
AMD Jira instance used for QA ticket IDs (SWLSVROS-* prefix); URL pattern: https://amd.atlassian.net/browse/<QA_ID>.
